changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.quarantine_reattach_plan( p_tenant_id text, p_origin_collection text, p_quarantine_collection text, p_chashes text[], p_from_quarantine boolean ) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $plan$ WITH reg AS ( -- RDR-229 P3.5b: the registry ids of the two labels the caller passes, read once (label-kept registry reads). SELECT (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.name = p_origin_collection) AS o_id, (SELECT cc.collection_id FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.name = p_quarantine_collection) AS q_id, -- RDR-229 P3.7 (vectors-083): from gate 3 a quarantined chunk is the origin's by the origin's id, not by the label tag EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.rdr229_gate_latch WHERE gate = 'gate3') AS latched ), cand AS ( -- One row per named chash that exists in the origin or (p_from_quarantine, the dry run) in this origin's -- quarantine sibling. The origin row's metadata wins: a present chunk is judged by what the origin holds. SELECT r.h AS chash, decode(r.h, 'hex') AS chash_b, COALESCE(o.metadata, q.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) AS meta FROM unnest(p_chashes) AS r(h) LEFT JOIN nexus.chunks o ON o.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (o.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (o.collection_id IS NULL AND o.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '')) AND o.chash = decode(r.h, 'hex') LEFT JOIN nexus.chunks q ON p_from_quarantine AND q.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (q.collection_id = (SELECT reg.q_id FROM reg) OR (q.collection_id IS NULL AND q.collection = p_quarantine_collection AND p_quarantine_collection <> '')) AND q.chash = decode(r.h, 'hex') AND CASE WHEN (SELECT reg.latched FROM reg) THEN q.metadata->'origin_collection_id' = to_jsonb((SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg)) ELSE COALESCE(q.metadata->>'origin_collection', p_origin_collection) = p_origin_collection END WHERE o.chash IS NOT NULL OR q.chash IS NOT NULL ), keyed AS ( SELECT c.*, NULLIF(COALESCE(NULLIF(c.meta->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(c.meta->>'doc_id', '')), '') AS fwd_key, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (m.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (m.collection_id IS NULL AND m.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '')) AND m.chash = c.chash_b) AS owned FROM cand c ), fwd AS ( -- The forward owner: a LIVE document anywhere in the tenant (the census's precedence: a live forward owner -- wins even when it is registered under another collection, in which case the chunk is not ours to attach). SELECT k.chash, d.tumbler, d.title, d.physical_collection, d.physical_collection_id, d.chunk_count, d.index_state, d.index_content_hash AS doc_hash FROM keyed k JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND d.tumbler = k.fwd_key AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ), rev_all AS ( SELECT k.chash, d.tumbler, d.title, d.chunk_count, d.index_state, d.index_content_hash AS doc_hash FROM keyed k JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (d.physical_collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (d.physical_collection_id IS NULL AND d.physical_collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '')) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(d.file_path, '') = '' AND d.metadata->>'doc_id' = k.chash WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fwd f WHERE f.chash = k.chash) ), rev AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.chash) a.chash, a.tumbler, a.title, a.chunk_count, a.index_state, a.doc_hash, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.chash) AS n FROM rev_all a ORDER BY a.chash, a.tumbler ), own AS ( SELECT f.chash, f.tumbler, f.title, f.chunk_count, f.index_state, f.doc_hash, 'forward'::text AS path, COALESCE(f.physical_collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (f.physical_collection_id IS NULL AND f.physical_collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> ''), false) AS in_origin, 1::bigint AS n FROM fwd f UNION ALL SELECT v.chash, v.tumbler, v.title, v.chunk_count, v.index_state, v.doc_hash, 'reverse'::text, true, v.n FROM rev v ), placed AS ( SELECT k.chash, k.chash_b, k.meta, k.owned, o.tumbler, o.title, o.chunk_count, o.index_state, o.doc_hash, o.path, o.in_origin, o.n, CASE WHEN o.tumbler IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN o.path = 'forward' AND k.meta->>'chunk_index' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (k.meta->>'chunk_index')::integer WHEN COALESCE(o.chunk_count, 0) <= 1 THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS pos FROM keyed k LEFT JOIN own o ON o.chash = k.chash ), rival_rows AS MATERIALIZED ( -- Every OTHER chunk, in the origin or in ANY quarantine collection that holds chunks tagged for this origin, -- whose forward key names one of the documents being judged, whichever path (forward or reverse) placed the -- chunk on it: the stored versions of the document, not only the chashes this call names. Two chunks that claim -- one (document, position) are two versions of it, and a call that took only one of them (a 1000-row page -- boundary, a second call, the other sibling) must still see the other. A single-chunk legacy note (reverse -- path, position 0) is judged the same way: a keyed chunk that names the note at position 0 (or, the note -- registering at most one chunk, at no position) is its rival. The origin and p_quarantine_collection are -- scanned as before (an untagged chunk there is taken for this origin's); any OTHER quarantine collection of -- the tenant counts only for a chunk whose origin_collection tag names this origin, so a chunk of another -- origin in a shared sibling is no rival. One scan of the origin and the siblings. SELECT x.chash AS x_chash, COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) AS x_key, x.metadata->>'chunk_index' AS x_ci FROM nexus.chunks x WHERE x.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND (x.collection_id IN ((SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg), (SELECT reg.q_id FROM reg)) OR (x.collection_id IS NULL AND ((x.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> '') OR (x.collection = p_quarantine_collection AND p_quarantine_collection <> '')))) AND CASE WHEN (SELECT reg.latched FROM reg) THEN (x.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR x.metadata->'origin_collection_id' = to_jsonb((SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg))) ELSE COALESCE(x.metadata->>'origin_collection', p_origin_collection) = p_origin_collection END AND COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) IN (SELECT pp.tumbler FROM placed pp WHERE pp.tumbler IS NOT NULL) UNION ALL -- The other quarantine collections, one indexed probe per collection (a join, not an OR, so the collection -- index is used); a chunk counts only when its own tag names this origin. SELECT x.chash, COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')), x.metadata->>'chunk_index' FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc JOIN nexus.chunks x ON x.tenant_id = cc.tenant_id AND (x.collection_id = cc.collection_id OR (x.collection_id IS NULL AND x.collection = cc.name AND cc.name <> '')) WHERE cc.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND cc.lifecycle_state = 'quarantine' AND cc.name <> p_quarantine_collection AND CASE WHEN (SELECT reg.latched FROM reg) THEN x.metadata->'origin_collection_id' = to_jsonb((SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg)) ELSE x.metadata->>'origin_collection' = p_origin_collection END AND COALESCE(NULLIF(x.metadata->>'catalog_doc_id', ''), NULLIF(x.metadata->>'doc_id', '')) IN (SELECT pp.tumbler FROM placed pp WHERE pp.tumbler IS NOT NULL) ), judged AS ( SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.owned THEN 'owned' WHEN p.tumbler IS NULL OR p.n <> 1 OR NOT p.in_origin THEN 'no_live_owner' -- The document's own state decides before its position does: a document that is mid index run, or -- stamped complete, has a manifest that is authoritative for its text (a complete stamp is verified -- against the manifest, so a manifest-less chunk of it is stale by definition, and a document -- emptied on purpose reads chunk_count 0 and complete). Legacy documents are unstamped. WHEN p.index_state = 'indexing' THEN 'superseded:indexing' WHEN p.index_state = 'complete' THEN 'superseded:complete' -- An index run that FAILED (CatalogRepository.failIndexRun) leaves whatever manifest it had written: -- partial, and unknown to this function. Refuse rather than guess, as for a mid-run document. WHEN p.index_state = 'failed' THEN 'superseded:failed' WHEN p.pos IS NULL THEN 'no_position' -- The chunk records the content hash of the file version it was cut from; a document that has -- since been indexed from other content records a different one. WHEN NULLIF(p.meta->>'content_hash', '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(p.doc_hash, '') IS NOT NULL AND p.meta->>'content_hash' <> p.doc_hash THEN 'superseded:version' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler AND m.position = p.pos) THEN 'superseded:position_taken' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rival_rows r WHERE r.x_key = p.tumbler AND r.x_chash <> p.chash_b AND (CASE WHEN r.x_ci ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN r.x_ci::integer WHEN COALESCE(p.chunk_count, 0) <= 1 THEN 0 END) = p.pos) THEN 'superseded:rival' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler AND NOT COALESCE(m.collection_id = (SELECT reg.o_id FROM reg) OR (m.collection_id IS NULL AND m.collection = p_origin_collection AND p_origin_collection <> ''), false)) THEN 'superseded:other_collection' WHEN p.path = 'reverse' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m WHERE m.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND m.doc_id = p.tumbler) THEN 'superseded:has_rows' WHEN COALESCE(p.chunk_count, 0) > 0 AND p.pos >= p.chunk_count THEN 'superseded:past_end' ELSE 'attach' END AS v FROM placed p ) SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'chash', j.chash, 'verdict', split_part(j.v, ':', 1), 'why', NULLIF(split_part(j.v, ':', 2), ''), 'doc', CASE WHEN j.n = 1 THEN j.tumbler END, 'title', CASE WHEN j.n = 1 THEN j.title END, 'pos', j.pos, 'chunk_title', NULLIF(j.meta->>'title', ''), 'ls', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'line_start' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'line_start')::integer END, 'le', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'line_end' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'line_end')::integer END, 'cs', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'chunk_start_char' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'chunk_start_char')::integer END, 'ce', CASE WHEN j.meta->>'chunk_end_char' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN (j.meta->>'chunk_end_char')::integer END ) ORDER BY j.chash), '[]'::jsonb) FROM judged j; $plan$;
